name: dev.maildoctor/maildoctor
title: MailDoctor
description: Diagnose and fix email deliverability: SPF, DKIM, DMARC, blocklists. Exact DNS fixes.

tools.name: check_domain
tools.description: Diagnose a domain's email setup: SPF (incl. the 10 DNS-lookup limit), DKIM keys, DMARC policy, MX and mail provider, inbound spam-filter gateway, MTA-STS/TLS-RPT, and Spamhaus/SpamCop/Barracuda blocklists. Returns a grade A–F, a status per check, and the exact DNS TXT records to fix each problem, worst first. Also lists the services that send mail as the domain and whether each would fail DMARC under p=reject (safe_to_enforce). Use it when someone asks why their email goes to spam or bounces (for example Outlook 550 5.7.515 or Gmail 550 5.7.26), whether SPF/DKIM/DMARC is set up correctly, whether it is safe to move DMARC to p=reject, or how to fix email DNS.

dkim_selector.description: Optional custom DKIM selector if the domain uses a non-standard one

domain.description: Domain or email address, e.g. example.com or me@example.com

tools.name: get_dns_fixes
tools.description: Return every recommended email DNS fix for a domain as a BIND zone file, each record marked ADD or REPLACE. Use it to apply fixes through a DNS provider's zone import or API (Cloudflare, Route 53, Google Cloud DNS, Azure DNS).
